# TecBunny Solutions — full AI discovery guide

TecBunny Solutions Private Limited is a technology services company headquartered in Pernem, North Goa, India. We provide CCTV installation, access control, Wi‑Fi and LAN design, smart infrastructure, managed IT support, AMC services, and technical project delivery for hotels, offices, clinics, schools, retail stores, and growing businesses across Goa and Maharashtra.

## Core service areas
- CCTV and physical security systems
- Wi‑Fi, network infrastructure, and structured cabling
- Smart access control and RFID systems
- Smart infrastructure and building automation
- Managed IT support, AMC and endpoint administration
- Lifecycle hardware support and hardware procurement

## Location coverage
- Goa: Pernem, Mapusa, Siolim, Arambol, Anjuna, Parra, Panaji, Margao, Vasco da Gama
- Maharashtra: Mumbai, Pune
- Remote support across India
